steps.content: [Scene Change] Deep inside the maze outside the Ring
Boom! Bang! Ratatatatat...!!

steps.speaker: Human-Shaped Contamination
steps.content: Gurgh...!!

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier
steps.content: Charge!! Exterminate them!!

The battle inside the maze is fierce, or rather, the FAC soldiers are full of fighting spirit. Faced with the roaring Underground puppets, a group of thirty or so soldiers tear through them like a hot knife through butter.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Wow... Cool, as expected from the DisSea frontline combatants. No wonder the Executive Committee hates your guys' guts.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Back in April, they were practically begging the FAC to suppress the riots, but you guys didn't put in your full effort.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Stopping a rampaging crowd is much harder than exterminating monsters. Surely we can't aim these anti-Mania weapons at the citizens.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Didn't you borrow the Propulsion Type 023 in March and take it to the Drifter Camp? You didn't hurt anyone either, right?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: That's because I'm not very skilled... Look, it seems like you have a message on your special communicator. Is it from the 9th Agency?
Donald laughs and changes the subject. The FAC soldier says nothing else and puts the communicator to his ear for a few seconds before handing it to Donald.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: The 9th Agency. They're looking for you.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Alright, Mr. Executive Officer. Don't forget your business.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I know, I know, I gotta report back to your boss. I'll get it done. I've already confirmed the location, just waiting for you guys to arrive.

He pulls out a telescope and takes one last look at the suspicious spot confirmed just a few minutes ago. That part of the maze still looks strange. It's not the familiar Rustfire mechanism he knows, but something more twisted.
Amid that, he catches sight of a repulsive black umbrella.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Using the stronghold as the reference, the relative coordinates are (66, 109). I can't calculate it any more precisely, is that enough?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: It's okay. That person has absolute trust in her subordinates.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Her subordinates will create the conditions for her, and she's now all fired up for it.
As he talks, Donald keeps his gaze on the man in black. As if sensing something, the man turns around.

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: Not bad. The news has reached you fast enough.
...Bang!

A gunshot, and the puppets in the front row all suddenly begin to disintegrate, screaming and twisting. Donald can't see the bullet's trajectory clearly, but it's obvious that the guy holding the umbrella on a clear day took the shot calmly and collapsed on the ground in a practiced manner.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Woah... So that's Causality. How cool is that?
Donald rubs his head. Matilda is already a horrifyingly good sniper, but apparently there are other gifted sharpshooters in the city-state.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: This skill has a long cooldown time, but it should be enough to hold him down. The 9th Agency will get to work soon. I'll leave the maze to you. There isn't much time left, I hope you can seize the chance.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: This Undergrounder is particularly cunning. Please be extra careful.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Sure thing. Thanks to big shots like you, everything has gone smoothly so far.
His eyes shift and glimpse a hissing filthy worm ready to backstab a soldier. Donald subconsciously raises his hand reflexively to snap his fingers, gathering an arc of electricity...
Shoot! He realizes and puts his hand down to stop his own attack, almost spraining his thumb in the haste.
Fortunately, the soldier is skillful enough. He turns around and fires a shot, then grins at the flustered Executive Officer.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: Itching for a real fight finally?

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Yeah, hanging out with the Executive Committee guys all this time, I haven't seen rowdy fellas like you guys in a while. It's hyping me up, I wanna play at being a cool soldier for once. Please protect me when there's real danger though.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: You're being modest. We've heard legends about you during the uprising. The mad Executive Officer who ventured into the Drifter Camp seven times to save refugees. The Executive Committee might laugh at you, but over here, many admire you.

steps.speaker: FAC Officer
steps.content: By the way, the city-state has significantly reduced its restrictions on Sinners. Official military forces, including the FAC, now accept Sinners. As long as they are mentally stable and confirmed safe by the MBCC, they're allowed to participate in combat.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hey, hey, don't get your hopes too high on me. I ain't got any superpowers. All I do is let people down.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: It's just that I haven't stepped onto the battlefield with others for a long time. I'm just feeling... a bit nostalgic.
With that, he picks up his spear and throws it hard, impaling two puppets and pinning them onto a wall over a dozen meters away.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: I'll see you in a bit!
